title: 1 SOLRS restores fire truck with rare in-house engine swap
description: U.S. Vehicle Management Airmen assigned to the 1st Special Operations Wing conduct an in-house engine swap on a fire truck at Hurlburt Field, Florida, May 28, 2025. The effort extended the truck’s service life and supported flight line readiness while providing valuable hands-on experience for junior maintainers. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Raul Mercado)
keywords: AFSOC, engine swap out, 1 SOLRS, Hurlburt Field
